stories.story_fr: Le 30 octobre 2025, Boardwalk a signe un accord preliminaire pour son projet Texas Gateway, qui ajouterait 1,5 Bcf/j de capacite pour relier l'offre des hubs de Katy et Carthage (Texas) a la demande croissante du sud-ouest de la Louisiane. Cela porte le total des projets de croissance annonces de Boardwalk a 4,2 Bcf/j de capacite additionnelle, pour un cout agrege anticipe d'environ 3,0 milliards de dollars.
stories.story_en: On October 30, 2025, Boardwalk executed a precedent agreement for its Texas Gateway Project, adding 1.5 Bcf/d of capacity, bringing total announced growth projects to 4.2 Bcf/d at an anticipated cost of approximately $3.0 billion.
stories.signal: On October 30, 2025, Boardwalk executed a precedent agreement for its Texas Gateway Project, which would add 1.5 Bcf d of capacity to connect supply from Katy and Carthage, Texas hubs to growing demand in Southwest Louisiana near Gillis. This brings Boardwalk s total announced growth projects to 4.2 Bcf d of additional capacity at an anticipated aggregate cost of approximately $3.0 billion.

stories.story_fr: La semaine precedant la publication des resultats du T1 2026, Boardwalk a finalise l'acquisition de Spire Marketing pour 215 millions de dollars. L'entite opere desormais sous le nom de Continuum. La transaction a ete autofinancee.
stories.story_en: Just before the Q1 2026 results, Boardwalk completed the acquisition of Spire Marketing for $215 million, now operating as Continuum, in a self-funded transaction.
stories.signal: Just last week, Boardwalk completed the acquisition of Spire Marketing for $215 million, now operating as Continuum, a transaction that was self-funded

stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, CNA a enregistre deux elements notables : une charge de reserves de 106 millions de dollars et une hausse de 2,6 points du ratio de sinistralite sous-jacent. Sur plusieurs branches dommages aux tiers (casualty), des annees de survenance recentes se sont deteriorees de facon defavorable, conduisant CNA a reevaluer ses estimations anterieures et a renforcer ses reserves.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, CNA recorded a $106 million reserve charge and a 2.6-point increase in the underlying loss ratio, reflecting adverse development in recent casualty accident years.
stories.signal: At CNA, there were two notable components to the quarter a $106 million reserve charge and a 2.6-point increase in the underlying loss ratio.
